heading: Snippets shortcut fix and documentation corrections
summary: Fix ⌘P in the application menu so it opens Snippets, correct the 1.1.4 notes, and improve the Quick Guide.
changes: ⌘P opens Snippets from both the application menu and the SSH terminal. Terminal Triggers open from the SSH toolbar and no longer use ⌘P.
The README, user guides, and LLM reference files describe the shortcut and the Terminal Triggers entry point accurately.
Add a transfer queue and folder compare section and match the reconnect message the app shows.
Preferences → Shortcuts shows a dash for actions without a keyboard shortcut.
notice: Requires macOS 13 or later on Apple Silicon. Saved agent tokens remain local and are never written into skill files.
